project.name: zeitflow-ai
project.description: Rethinking the way you work with AI using a unique, powerful system for managing and executing AI prompt chains

Queue.description: A Queue contains multiple Chains, each representing a sequence of Steps to be executed.

Chain.description: A Chain represents a named sequence of Steps, associated with a cycle number.

Step.description: A Step represents a single prompt execution within a Chain, tracking its cycle, prompt, and results.

Result.description: A Result captures the output of a Step, including the result string and a reference to the originating Step.

notes: See Figma for UI/UX design inspiration.
Considerations: OpenAI integration, rate limits, token spend/usage tracking.
